description: This file defines the SizeTracker trait used in Apache Spark to estimate the size of collections in bytes, employing sampling with exponential back-off to amortize the cost of size estimation.

classes.name: SizeTracker
classes.description: A trait for tracking and estimating the size of collections in bytes using sampling and exponential back-off.

methods.name: resetSamples
methods.description: Resets the sampling data, to be called after significant size changes.

methods.name: afterUpdate
methods.description: Callback to be invoked after each update to potentially take a new sample.

methods.name: takeSample
methods.description: Takes a new size sample of the collection.

methods.name: estimateSize
methods.description: Estimates the current size of the collection in bytes.
